title: Sender identity metadata missing from user prompt on bare /new and /reset
body:
## Summary

On bare `/new` and `/reset`, the sender identity metadata (`Conversation info` + `Sender` blocks containing `chat_id`, `sender_id`, `sender`) is computed but not included in the user message prompt. The model receives zero sender identity on session bootstrap, despite the Telegram plugin (and all channel plugins) correctly extracting it from the inbound message.

## Impact

Any agent relying on sender identity for role-based behavior (e.g., greeting by name, applying different permissions per user) cannot resolve the sender on `/new` or `/reset`. The identity only becomes available on the second message. This affects all channels, not just Telegram.

## Root Cause

In `src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply.ts`, the `baseBodyForPrompt` construction has two branches:

```typescript
const baseBodyForPrompt = isBareSessionReset ? [
    startupContextPrelude,
    baseBodyFinal,
    softResetTail ? \`User note...\` : ""
].filter(Boolean).join("\\n\\n")
: [inboundUserContext, baseBodyFinal].filter(Boolean).join("\\n\\n");
```

The `inboundUserContext` (output of `buildInboundUserContextPrefix()`) is included on normal messages (the `else` branch) but **excluded** on bare reset (the `isBareSessionReset` branch). The variable is computed ~10 lines above — it just isn't added to the array.

Meanwhile, `buildInboundMetaSystemPrompt()` (which goes into the system prompt) intentionally omits sender fields — it only includes `schema`, `account_id`, `channel`, `provider`, `surface`, `chat_type`, and `response_format`.

So on bare reset, sender identity exists in neither the system prompt nor the user message.

## Proposed Fix

Add `inboundUserContext` to the bare-reset branch:

```typescript
const baseBodyForPrompt = isBareSessionReset ? [
    inboundUserContext,       // ← sender identity on reset path
    startupContextPrelude,
    baseBodyFinal,
    softResetTail ? \`User note for this reset turn...\` : ""
].filter(Boolean).join("\\n\\n")
: [inboundUserContext, baseBodyFinal].filter(Boolean).join("\\n\\n");
```

## Why this is safe

- Command parsing (`isResetOrNewCommand`, `isBareNewOrReset`, authorization) is fully complete before `baseBodyForPrompt` is built
- `baseBodyForPrompt` only feeds into `effectiveBaseBody` → model prompt; it never feeds back into routing or command parsing
- `inboundUserContext` is already delivered on every non-reset message — this makes behavior consistent
- `/new <note>` (non-bare reset) already takes the `else` branch and includes `inboundUserContext`
- Token cost: ~150 tokens added to the reset prompt (negligible vs. startup context + daily memory already loaded)

## Verification

- Bare `/new` → model sees `Conversation info` + `Sender` blocks in user message
- Bare `/reset` → same
- `/new <note>` → unchanged (already works via `else` branch)
- Normal message → unchanged
- System prompt `Inbound Context` block → unchanged (no sender fields, by design)

## Environment

OpenClaw 2026.4.22 (00bd2cf)
Compiled location: `dist/get-reply-DIRI0vf6.js` line ~2174

diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
index 4bd7ce54b2e90..88d59e594893b 100644
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -54,6 +54,7 @@ Docs: https://docs.openclaw.ai
 - Native apps: advertise the Gateway protocol compatibility range so chat and node sessions can connect to v3 gateways after additive v4 client updates.
 - Gateway/agents: keep stale `sessions_send` ACP manager and `web_fetch` runtime chunks importable after package updates, preventing live gateways from breaking before restart. Fixes #78804. Thanks @Gomesy72.
 - Gateway/install: preserve service environment value-source metadata in `openclaw gateway install`, so systemd reinstall paths keep env-file-backed secrets out of inline unit metadata. Refs #77406, #77427. Thanks @stainlu and @brokemac79.
+- Auto-reply/reset: include inbound sender context in bare `/new` and `/reset` model prompts while keeping startup instructions out of transcript prompts, so agents see sender identity on the first reset turn. Fixes #77360. Thanks @srb11e.
 - Gateway: avoid synchronous restart-sentinel state probes during post-attach startup, preventing slow Windows or redirected state directories from blocking channel turns. Fixes #79264. Thanks @liyi58.
 - Agents/auth: update successful model auth profile status with one locked store write, reducing post-model reply latency from duplicate `auth-profiles.json` saves. Thanks @mcaxtr.
 - Agents/image: honor explicit `image` tool model overrides even when `agents.defaults.imageModel` is unset, restoring one-off vision calls for configured multimodal providers. Fixes #79341. Thanks @haumanto.
